system.description:
You manifest gauntlet of formed of illusionary pulses, that beat on the thought patterns of a creature, leaving it mentally drained.

All creatures within a 20-foot cone originating from you must make an Intelligence saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects but still takes 2d6 psychic damage

Failure: Affected creature takes 3d6 Psychic damage and gains 1 rank of Confused.

Critical Failure: Affected creature takes 6d6 Psychic damage and 2 ranks of Confused.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, damage by 1d6 and the size of the cone by 5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, creatures who failed their save must step back 10 feet or 20 feet on a critical failure. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher creatures who fail their save become Blinded until the end of their next turn or for the next minute on a critical failure, remaking their save to end the blindness early at the end of each of their turns. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher a creature who fail their save increase the cost of their next jutsu cast before the end of their next turn by +6 or +10 on a critical failure. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank or higher, for every creature that fails their saving throw, you gain 2 temporary Chakra until the end of your next turn.
